office_does: A Grays Harbor County District Court judge, elected countywide, hears misdemeanors and gross misdemeanors, traffic infractions and preliminary hearings, and sets bail.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Andrea Vingo, on the District Court bench for four years, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Grays Harbor District Court judge for four years and former Hoquiam Municipal Court judge; reports 30 years as an attorney, including as a prosecutor. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Won the seat in 2022 over Geoff Arnold with 54% of the vote [S4]
Hoquiam Municipal Court judge by 2017 appointment; earlier a prosecutor and Attorney General's Office civil rights attorney [S3]
Pledges fair, efficient and accessible justice and modernized court processes [S1]
